correctness.rationale: For two distinct curves mu+K(t+c)^(-p), their derivative difference vanishes at most twice because the log derivative of the ratio of shifted powers has an affine numerator and at most one extremum. Rolle then bounds rate intersections by three; with common known background direct equality of two shifted powers has at most two intersections. Zero integrals over four ordered nonoverlapping positive-length windows induce four distinct crossing points (unless the analytic difference is identically zero), forcing global injectivity. The four columns of the intensity Jacobian, after multiplication by z^(p+1), span A z^(p+1)+Bz+C+Dz log z; z h""=A p(p+1) z^p +D has at most one root, establishing a Chebyshev zero bound, nonsingularity of integrated four-window Jacobian, and rank of three columns for any three windows. The implicit function theorem therefore supplies a positive local 1D fibre for three windows; likewise known-mu rank two gives 2-window nonidentifiability. Independent exact symbolic checks confirmed the three-root example -(t-3)(11t^2-12t+2) and two-root known-background example (5±sqrt17)/4. Claims concern exact expected counts, not stochastic realized counts or conditioning.
